description: This Kotlin source file contains UI test cases for verifying the display of Snackbars in different screen configurations within an Android Compose application. It uses Robolectric for testing, Hilt for dependency injection, and includes setup for test environments such as device size and theme. The tests simulate showing Snackbars and capture screenshots for verification.

classes.name: SnackbarScreenshotTests
classes.description: A test class configured to run UI tests with Robolectric, focusing on the display and screenshot capture of Snackbars across various device sizes and configurations. It uses Hilt for dependency injection, and contains multiple test methods simulating snackbar appearances.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes dependency injection and sets up test data before each test, including user onboarding status and followed topics.

methods.name: setTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone to UTC for deterministic test behavior.

methods.name: phone_noSnackbar
methods.description: Test case that captures screenshot when no Snackbar is shown on a phone-sized screen.

methods.name: snackbarShown_phone
methods.description: Test case that shows a Snackbar on a phone-sized screen and captures its screenshot.

methods.name: snackbarShown_foldable
methods.description: Test case that shows a Snackbar on a foldable device-sized screen and captures its screenshot.

methods.name: snackbarShown_tablet
methods.description: Test case that shows a Snackbar on a tablet-sized screen and captures its screenshot.

methods.name: testSnackbarScreenshotWithSize
methods.description: Helper method that sets up the compose environment with specific device size, shows the Snackbar if specified, and captures a screenshot for visual verification.
